verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any official Adyen SDK or client library for in-person payments. The docs say the Terminal API uses JSON messages "without the need for libraries". The OpenAPI definition files in the adyen-openapi repo are a developer building block for generating clients, not an official SDK, so they earn no credit. The auth SDK reference concerns business accounts, a different product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
